items.raw_excerpt: Several hundred Ceuta residents took to the streets again on Sunday to protest the mass influx of migrants into their city, which occurred last month and is still having an effect.
items.summary_en: Hundreds of residents in Ceuta, Spain held another protest against a large wave of migrants who entered their city last month. The demonstrations marked one month since the influx began. Locals say the event continues to affect their daily lives.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 세우타에서 수백 명의 주민들이 한 달 전 대규모 이주자 유입에 반대하는 시위를 다시 한번 열었다. 이번 집회는 유입 사태가 시작된 지 한 달이 된 것을 기념하는 것이다. 주민들은 여전히 도시의 일상에 영향이 계속되고 있다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Ceuta residents protest one month after migrant surge
items.title_ko: 스페인 세우타에서 대규모 이주자 유입 후 시위 지속
items.title_original: Another day of protests in Ceuta mark a month since migrant influx

items.raw_excerpt: September is a historic turning point in Norway. For the first time in 35 years, the country starts a new month with a new monarch, along with several important changes and the arrival of autumn.
items.summary_en: Norway enters September 2026 with a historic change. For the first time in 35 years the country begins a month under a new monarch. Several everyday rules and routines also shift with the start of autumn.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이는 2026년 9월을 맞아 35년 만에 새 군주 아래 새로운 달을 시작합니다. 가을이 오면서 일상의 여러 규칙과 습관도 함께 바뀝니다.
items.title_en: September 2026: What changes in daily life in Norway
items.title_original: Key points: Everything that changes about life in Norway in September 2026

items.raw_excerpt: In the third round of 2026 referendums, to be held on September 27th, Swiss voters will have their say on a variety of issues of both national and cantonal importance.
items.summary_en: Several Swiss cantons will hold referendums on September 27th. Voters will decide on tax changes and assisted-dying rules that affect their local communities.
items.summary_ko: 스위스 여러 주가 9월 27일 주민투표를 앞두고 있다. 주민들은 각 지역의 세금 개정과 안락사 관련 규칙을 직접 결정하게 된다.
items.title_en: Swiss cantons set September votes on taxes and assisted dying
